# Bs2FoB

> Essays by Bs2FoB on cognition, reasoning tools and method, published in Korean (original) and English. The core is the Cognitive Axioms series (인지공리).

Every post is a static HTML file readable without JavaScript. Korean files end in `.ko.html`, English files in `.en.html`; the Korean text is the original and the English is the author's translation. Verse posts have a single file that carries the Korean poem with an English gloss. Series numbers read `set_part` (e.g. `02_3` is set 2, part 3). Machine-readable index: https://bs2fob.com/posts.json

## Writing

- [<Cognitive Axioms 01_0> Established Foothold](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w376v154_foothold.en.html): Finishing is not perfecting. A procedure for deciding what unit of work counts as done. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w376v154_foothold.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 02_1> Abduction](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v164_abduction.en.html): Only abduction opens a hypothesis space. Deduction and induction work inside it. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v164_abduction.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 02_2> The Pragmatic Maxim and Information Theory](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v165_maxim.en.html): How to judge what abduction opens: Peirce's maxim and Shannon's information. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v165_maxim.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 02_3> The Intelligence Trichotomy](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v170_trichotomy.en.html): HI · SI · PI. Splitting what the word intelligence lumps together into three. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v170_trichotomy.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 03_1> The Emergence of Lifeforms](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v175_living.en.html): Entropy and time, attractors and Hamilton, and how local order emerged as lifeforms: devices that accelerate dissipation. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v175_living.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 03_2> The Emergence of the Living Cognizer](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v180_mind.en.html): From the Cambrian explosion to writing: lifeforms that acquired a cognitive system for handling representations. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v180_mind.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 03_3> The Default Settings of the Living Cognizer](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v181_default.en.html): There is no flawless agent. Ambiguity and anxiety are the defaults of the living cognizer. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v181_default.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_1> Axis Coordinate Systems](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v170_axes.en.html): The basic component of cognitive computation is the axis coordinate system: number of axes, axis names, units, coordinates. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v170_axes.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_2> The Absence of Transformation](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v171_transform.en.html): Real cognitive computation has no transformation. What can't be carried over gets borrowed. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v171_transform.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_3> Identity Is a Matter of Scale](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v172_identity.en.html): Mercury's orbit, manufacturing tolerances, yesterday's self. Being the same means the difference falls below the scale. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v172_identity.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_4> Tensors and JSON](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v173_tensor.en.html): In an axis coordinate system, only the coordinates are in focus. JSON is the container that pairs them with axis names and carries them. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v173_tensor.ko.html

## VoxSermo

- [That Damned Ether](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v084_voxchat0003.en.html): A dialogue that starts from the origin of ether and ends where the demand to get rid of magic is met by spacetime without ether, splitting into the graviton and Navier–Stokes. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v084_voxchat0003.ko.html
- [The Mind to Keep, the Mind to Choose](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v053_voxchat0002.en.html): A dialogue that starts from the ceiling on human lifespan and ends at a body that can be replaced, a mind that must stay the original, and power that must be filtered by the mind. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v053_voxchat0002.ko.html
- [From Time to Mass](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v174_voxchat0001.en.html): A dialogue that starts from which physical quantity is defined first and ends at mass as frequency in time while at rest in space. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v174_voxchat0001.ko.html

## Snap

- [LDL, Atherosclerosis, apoB](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v150_apob.en.html): One scene: cholesterol as a delivery box. Starting from the fact that the box has no address, and ending where every driver of atherosclerosis converges on one number, the count of apoB particles in the blood. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v150_apob.ko.html
- [A Story About Salt](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v012_salt.en.html): One tub of salted fish. From the number stamped under a container, through cans and wrappers, to the salt on the table. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v012_salt.ko.html
- [Why Billing Needs a Fixed Basis](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v162_billing.en.html): 1% used. Of what? One gauge with no denominator, and why AI services need a billing basis that never changes. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v162_billing.ko.html
- [Particle Physics and the Established Foothold](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v144_fob.en.html): Dr. Park Moon-ho's lecture, 33:50 to 1:19:34. From the discovery of the nucleus to the Copenhagen institute: each foothold secured, then used as the next starting point. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v144_fob.ko.html
- [A Word About Claymore](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v193_claymore.en.html): How far do you open it? One gauge, and from there the template that charges cannibalism as the price — where it started and how far it spread. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v193_claymore.ko.html

## Optional

- [A Few Changes to Structure and Settings](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v183_changes.en.html): The Lexicon tab is out and a VoxSermo tab is in. I also added a Copy URL button for individual posts, plus a middle layer that carries each post's title into messenger previews. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v183_changes.ko.html
- [Counter Reset](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v014_reset.en.html): Automating Wayback Machine pinning put the crawler on my counter, so I reset it to zero and stopped counting Linux-header visits. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v014_reset.ko.html
- [Wayback Machine](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v153_wayback.en.html): The site-pinning space I've long known, archive.org, turns out to be the Wayback Machine, a way to prove originality. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v153_wayback.ko.html
- [Previous and Next Buttons](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v021_prevnext.en.html): Each post now ends with buttons to the previous and next pieces in its tab, laid out to match the direction of that tab’s list. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v021_prevnext.ko.html
- [Tuning the Threshold](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v211_threshold.en.html): I lowered the entry to the 04 set with everyday material. Compressed statement is my default; easing it for readers is an extra service. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v211_threshold.ko.html
- [Reordering the Lists](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v202_order.en.html): The Writing and Verse tabs now list from the first piece. The earlier pieces weigh far more than the later ones. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v202_order.ko.html
- [Renumbering, and a Few Other Things](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v180_renumber.en.html): Cognitive Axioms numbering is now ##_#. And the question of identity and similarity that stayed with me through the 04 set. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v180_renumber.ko.html
- [Up to 007 Without Much Thought](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v193_pause.en.html): What began with the intelligence trichotomy ran on to 007. The active living cognizer is on hold for now. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v193_pause.ko.html
- [AI Handling Devices](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v004_handling.en.html): The devices that steer the AI in Claude Code, ordered by how hard they bind. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v004_handling.ko.html
- [Delegate Deterministic Operations to External Tools](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w385v094_delegate.en.html): One wall an LLM can never climb: answering deterministic operations head-on with nothing but probabilistic inference. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w385v094_delegate.ko.html
- [A Verse Tab](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v161_versetab.en.html): A Verse tab went in between Log and Writing. Four digits, so 9999 slots. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v161_versetab.ko.html
- [Reworking the Tabs](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v135_tabs.en.html): Review became Snap, and a Lexicon tab went in. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v135_tabs.ko.html
- [Rewriting 001, and a few settings](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w383v121_log.en.html): The tone got reset and the fertilizer section went in. Justified text, mobile layout, and the numbering scheme are now decided. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w383v121_log.ko.html
- [What the next stretch looks like](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w376v181_notice.en.html): Still settling the setup. For a while the work is splitting older drafts into short pieces and putting them up. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w376v181_notice.ko.html
